notes: Layout source bytes are a synthetic adapter capture (compact sorted UTF-8 JSON); SP-273 says these digests bind the bytes the Home source adapter actually supplies and do not make the fixture encoder the canonical Home serializer. Identity capture and migration-core bytes use canonical MessagePack (DL-270). Each invalid case applies its ops to the named valid case; rejected_by names the schema or the invariant (I1-I9 in the schema's $comment) that refuses it. Round 1 (2026-11-04, review DS-SOL-01/02): payload_store is a synthetic SP-337 payload store (BLAKE3 id, media type, exact bytes). A stored_value_ref case stores the complete canonical MessagePack value by reference; an invalid case may carry payload_store_ops (remove, flip_byte, set_media_type, put_derived) applied to a copy of the store. put_derived re-encodes a referenced value after value_ops, and the checker recomputes its BLAKE3 id. Valid stored sizes are measured against Plans/storage_value_registry.json max_value_bytes. 2026-11-05 sweep part 1: repair stale source/capture/hash copies and the multi-defect oversized-source fixture; same 10 positive / 30 schema-negative / 33 invariant-negative cases. Full clause isolation remains part 2. Malformed locator/media controls also keep their synthetic objects available and dependent source/hash/media observations coherent; implied syntax/hash/decoder guards remain for part-2 adjudication.
